description: Automerge minor and patch updates. Opt-in, not part of the baseline: no repo here protects `main`, so Renovate is the only gate, and it treats a repo with no CI as passing. A repo without a real test job must not extend this.
0.x minors are excluded. Under SemVer a pre-1.0 minor may break, and both SPM and Cargo resolve it happily while Renovate still labels it `minor` — so it needs a human.
Hold supported updates for three days before Renovate creates a branch. The default strict internal check keeps the update out of the repo while yanks and advisories have time to appear.

packageRules.description: Pre-1.0 minors are breaking changes wearing a minor's label.
